summary: Correct Qoder CN Flash extension and scope.
Add two Qoder Service Account clocks plus Alibaba Global Qwen3.7-Plus API night pricing.
Remove retired/unlisted models and the unsupported assertion that DeepSeek Pro always bills at Flash rates.
Include AutoClaw in the Z.ai campaign and clarify B.AI Chat versus API.

uncertainties: DeepSeek current table and Quick Start list separate V4 Pro access/prices; older release notice says Pro routes to Flash. Current pricing display follows the live table, not an unverified cheaper-route assumption.
AIHubMix aggregate and individual routes publish different schedules. Its existing approximate schedule is not a universal billing promise.

Z.ai Flash campaign publishes an October 7 end date and nightly 23:00–09:00 following-day windows, but no precise final cutoff instant. Existing window-start-date interpretation retained; confirm the final overnight boundary with Z.ai.
Codex announcement says PST (fixed UTC−8), not PDT. Countdown remains explicitly unofficial.
No replacement end date has been published for Qoder CN Flash. No expiry was invented.
No inference that Tencent, Alibaba, above.dev or Ollama follow DeepSeek's Chinese holiday exceptions.
